helloaloysius-greeting:
Greeting at the top of articles and on Special:Hello.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username, or "Aloysius" for logged-out readers
helloaloysius-subtitle: Line under the greeting on Special:Hello.
helloaloysius-random: Button that opens a random article.
helloaloysius-stat-articles: Label under the number of articles.
helloaloysius-stat-edits: Label under the total number of edits.
helloaloysius-stat-users: Label under the number of registered users.
helloaloysius-stat-youredits: Label under the reader's own edit count.
helloaloysius-recent-title: Heading above the list of latest edits.
helloaloysius-recent-empty: Shown when the wiki has no edits yet.
helloaloysius-footnote: Small note at the bottom of Special:Hello, for workshop students.
helloaloysius-readtime:
Estimated reading time.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of minutes
helloaloysius-words:
Number of words on the page.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of words
helloaloysius-saved-title: Title of the card shown after saving an edit.
helloaloysius-created-title: Title of the card shown after creating a new page.
helloaloysius-saved-body:
Body of the card shown after saving.

Parameters:
* $1 - the user's total edit count
helloaloysius-hook-note: Small note on the save card, naming the hook that made it appear.
